_meta.name: sem-wave-pair-derived-group
_meta.description: A wave pair chosen by request params, fitted as ONE two-group SEM on brand_survey.pulse. The ATTR_FORMULA period maps wave == params.from_wave to 1, wave == params.to_wave to 2 and every other wave to 0 (no level, so those rows drop listwise). MAT_SEM groups by that computed column (group: period) and declares its levels with group_levels, [{value 1, name from}, {value 2, name to}]: array order is the c(...) position, the names key the estimate rows ([from] / [to]), n_group_from and the group_reference (from, the first level). The model gives the value-on-service path a per-group label, value ~ c(bfrom, bto)*service, and the defined parameter shift := bto - bfrom is that path's change from the first wave to the second. params.from_wave and params.to_wave are wave LABELS (wave is categorical, and an expression reads a categorical as its dictionary string, so a number never matches): change them to compare another pair (swap them to read the change backwards) without editing the model. params reach the attribute expression only: the MAT_SEM params (model, group_reference) are plain JSON and take no params reference.

params.model:
quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3
value =~ v1 + v2 + v3
service =~ s1 + s2 + s3
value ~ c(bfrom, bto)*service
shift := bto - bfrom
